messages:
kai: Quick sync thread to lock the GA acceptance checklist. We need clear owners for SLA acceptance tests, docs & SDKs, billing credit policy, runbook rollback steps, and monitoring retention. Short and actionable.

nisha: I'll own the docs + SDKs. Missing: streaming example for multipart responses and a tiny operator quickstart (one-pager). Can land by Tue AM.

liam: I'll take SLA tests and rollback automation. Proposed SLOs: 99.9% availability, p99 latency <= 500ms for small requests, 5xx < 0.5%. I'll add a scripted harness and automated pass/fail job.

kai: Billing: FinOps can you confirm an emergency credit policy that is quick to apply? We need the wording for customer comms.

finops: Suggested: investigative window 72h, eligible customers get one-time credit up to $400 or pro-rated account credit. Legal must sign off on final language.

liam: Rollback criteria suggestion: availability < 99% for 10m OR error-rate > 2% for 5m -> immediate revert to pilot config. Revert must be runnable via infra CLI in < 3m. I'll add the exact commands to the runbook.

ops-bot: Oncall rota updated: primary = zara (Mon-Fri), weekend = omar. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/ga-cutover.

nisha: Alerts: page SRE if error-rate > 1% for 5m OR p99 > 30% over baseline for 10m. Token-cost drift < 25% -> non-paging ticket. I'll add examples in the runbook.

kai: Owners recap: Product = kai (acceptance), Eng = liam (SLA/tests + rollback), Docs = nisha, FinOps/legal = finops (billing text). If anyone can't hit their deliverable, flag now.

liam: Opening SLA test PR and CI job tonight.

nisha: Docs PR will include streaming snippet and operator quickstart. Tagging reviewers.

kai: Action items summary: 1) liam: SLA harness + rollback commands; 2) nisha: docs + SDK streaming; 3) finops: draft customer credit wording; 4) ops: ensure runbook runnable. Cutover target Wed 10:00 if green by Tue EOD.

liam: :thumbsup: will update status here when CI is green.

nisha: PRs opened (#501/#502). Reviewers requested.

kai: Thanks all — moving this to shiproom agenda and adding to the checklist.
